name: chrome-browser-mcp-monorepo
description: Next-gen Chrome Extension & MCP Server for AI browser use — real-session control, a11y/DOM/CDP inspection, and MCP Apps UI.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @chrome-browser-mcp/protocol build && pnpm --filter @chrome-browser-mcp/mcp-app build && pnpm --filter chrome-browser-mcp build && pnpm --filter @chrome-browser-mcp/extension build
